summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping, exported it from the Databricks package and the profiles package, and registered it directly after the token mapping in profile_mappings. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim, selection, profile output, auth/secret override protection, and env vars. Tests were not run (per instructions); verification was by reading only. Nothing committed.
